field.name: NRST_MDSEL[1:0]
field.description: NRST pin mode selection. 01: A low level on the NRST pin can reset system, internal reset can not drive NRST pin. 10: NRST pin function as normal GPIO, and only internal RESET. 11: NRST pin configure as input/output mode.

field.name: nBOOT0
field.description: BOOT0 option bit 0: BOOT0 is 1 1: BOOT0 is 0

field.name: nBOOT1
field.description: BOOT1 option bit 0: BOOT1 is 1 1: BOOT1 is 0 Together with the BOOT0 pin, this bit selects boot mode

field.name: SWBT0
field.description: Software BOOT0 0: BOOT0 taken from PA14/BOOT0 pin 1: BOOT0 taken from the option bit nBOOT0

field.name: SRAM_PCK_EN
field.description: SRAM parity check enable 0: SRAM parity check enable 1: SRAM parity check disable

field.name: HXTAL_REMAP
field.description: HXTAL remapping 0: Remapping enable 1: Remapping disable When this bit is set to 0, the HXTAL clock source will be remapped from PF0-OSC_IN / PF1-OSC_OUT pins to PC14-OSCX_IN/ PC15-OSCX_OUT. Thus PC14-OSCX_IN / PC15-OSCX_OUT are shared by both LXTAL and HXTAL and the two clock sources cannot be use simultaneously

field.name: nWWDG_HW
field.description: Window watchdog configuration bit 0: Hardware window watchdog 1: Software window watchdog

field.name: nFWDG_HW
field.description: Free watchdog configuration bit 0: Hardware free watchdog 1: Software free watchdog

field.name: nRST_STDBY
field.description: Option byte standby reset value 0: Generates a reset if entering standby mode 1: No reset if entering standby mode

field.name: nRST_DPSLP
field.description: Option byte deepsleep reset value 0: Generates a reset if entering deepsleep mode 1: No reset if entering deepsleep mode

field.name: BORF_TH[1:0]
field.brief: BOR threshold at falling VDD supply
field.description: BOR threshold at falling VDD supply Falling VDD crossings this threshold activates the reset signal. 00: BOR falling level 1 with threshold around 2.0 V 01: BOR falling level 2 with threshold around 2.2 V 10: BOR falling level 3 with threshold around 2.5 V 11: BOR falling level 4 with threshold around 2.8 V

field.name: BORR_TH[1:0]
field.brief: BOR threshold at rising VDD supply
field.description: BOR threshold at rising VDD supply Falling VDD crossings this threshold activates the reset signal. 00: BOR rising level 1 with threshold around 2.1 V 01: BOR rising level 2 with threshold around 2.3 V 10: BOR rising level 3 with threshold around 2.6 V 11: BOR rising level 4 with threshold around 2.9 V

field.name: BORST_EN
field.description: Brown out reset enable 0: Brown out reset disable, power-on reset defined by POR/PDR levels 1: Brown out reset enable, values of BORR_TH and BORF_TH taken into account

field.name: SPC[7:0]
field.brief: Security protection level option byte status bits
field.description: Security protection level option byte status bits 0xAA: No protection 0xCC: Protection level high, chip read protection enabled Any value except 0xAA or 0xCC: Protection level low, memory read protection enabled

field.name: DCRP0_SADDR[6:0]
field.description: DCRP area 0 start address DCRP0_SADDR contains the offset of the first subpage of the DCRP area 0.

field.name: DCRP_EREN
field.brief: DCRP area erase enable configuration bit
field.description: DCRP area erase enable configuration bit. 0: DCRP is not erased when SPC value in FMC_OBCTL register is decreased from value 1 to value 0. 1: DCRP is erased when SPC value in FMC_OBCTL register is decreased from value 1 to value 0..

field.name: DCRP0_EADDR[6:0]
field.description: DCRP area 1 end address offset DCRP0_EADDR contains the offset of the last subpage of the DCRP area 1.

field.name: WP0_EADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 0 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 0 end address offset WP0_EADDR contains the last page of Write protect area 0.

field.name: WP0_SADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 0 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 0 end address offset WP0_SADDR contains the first page of Write protect area 0.

field.name: WP1_EADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 1 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 1 end address offset WP1_EADDR contains the last page of Write protect area 1

field.name: WP1_SADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 1 start address offset
field.description: Write protection area 1 start address offset WP1_SADDR contains the first page of Write protect area 1

field.name: DCRP1_SADDR[6:0]
field.description: DCRP area 1 start address offset DCRP1_SADDR contains the offset of the first subpage of the DCRP area 1

field.name: DCRP1_EADDR[6:0]
field.description: DCRP area 1 end address offset DCRP1_EADDR contains the offset of the last subpage of the DCRP area 1.

field.name: BOOTLK
field.brief: This bit is set to force boot from user Flash area
field.description: This bit is set to force boot from user Flash area. 0: Support flash, ram and system boot 1: Only boot from main flash

field.name: SCR_PAGE_CNT[6:0]
field.brief: Configure the number of pages in secue user area
field.description: Configure the number of pages in secue user area. Secue user area starts at memory 0x0800 0000.The memory size is SCR_PAGE_CNT * page size.
